description:
Sneha Sparsha is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Karnataka on 1st June 2020. 

The scheme is specifically designed to provide financial assistance to women and children who are victims of domestic violence. 

The primary objective of Sneha Sparsha is to ensure the safety and well-being of women and children by providing them with necessary support. 

The scheme aims to empower women by providing them with legal aid and counseling services. 

Additionally, it seeks to create awareness about domestic violence and the rights of women and children. 

The Karnataka government has set a target to reach at least 10,000 beneficiaries under this scheme within the first year of its implementation. 

The benefits provided under the Sneha Sparsha scheme include financial assistance of ₹2,000 per month for a duration of six months. 

This financial support is aimed at helping women and children meet their basic needs during a crisis. 

The scheme also includes provisions for medical assistance and counseling services for the victims. 

Eligibility criteria for the Sneha Sparsha scheme include women who are above the age of 18 years. 

Applicants must be residents of Karnataka and should have been victims of domestic violence. 

Income criteria stipulate that the annual family income should not exceed ₹2,00,000. 

Women who have filed a complaint regarding domestic violence with the police or a women's helpline are eligible for assistance. 

The application process for the Sneha Sparsha scheme is straightforward. 

Interested beneficiaries must visit the nearest Women and Child Development Department office. 

They need to fill out an application form that is available at the office. 

Required documents include identity proof such as Aadhar card or voter ID. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of residence and income certificate. 

A complaint or FIR regarding domestic violence must also be submitted. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the officials of the Women and Child Development Department. 

Eligible beneficiaries will receive the financial assistance directly into their bank accounts. 

The disbursement of funds is scheduled to occur within 15 days of the application approval. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Women and Child Development, Government of Karnataka. 

For any inquiries or assistance, beneficiaries can contact the department at their helpline number 1098. 

The scheme also collaborates with various NGOs to provide additional support services. 

Awareness campaigns are conducted regularly to inform women about their rights and available services. 

The government has allocated a budget of ₹50 crores for the initial phase of the Sneha Sparsha scheme. 

This budget is intended to cover the financial assistance and operational costs of the program. 

Monitoring and evaluation of the scheme are conducted periodically to assess its impact. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the services provided under the scheme. 

The Sneha Sparsha scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Karnataka government to combat domestic violence. 

It aligns with the National Policy for Women which emphasizes the need for women's empowerment. 

The scheme also complements other welfare programs aimed at supporting women and children in distress. 

As of October 2023, the scheme has successfully reached over 12,000 beneficiaries since its launch. 

The government has reported a significant increase in awareness about domestic violence issues among women. 

Counseling services provided under the scheme have been instrumental in helping victims regain confidence. 

Legal aid services have also been made available to assist women in filing cases against their abusers. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from various women's rights organizations. 

They have commended the government for taking a proactive approach to address domestic violence. 

The success of the Sneha Sparsha scheme has led to discussions about its expansion to other states. 

The Karnataka government is considering increasing the financial assistance amount in future phases. 

The scheme has also inspired similar initiatives in neighboring states. 

Overall, the Sneha Sparsha scheme represents a significant step towards addressing the issue of domestic violence in Karnataka. 

It provides a comprehensive support system for women and children who are often left vulnerable. 

By offering financial assistance legal aid and counseling, the scheme aims to empower victims. 

The government continues to monitor the effectiveness of the scheme and make necessary adjustments. 

This ensures that the needs of the beneficiaries are met effectively. 

The initiative has become a model for other states to follow in combating domestic violence. 

In conclusion, the Sneha Sparsha scheme is a vital welfare initiative that addresses the pressing issue of domestic violence. 

It provides essential support to women and children ensuring their safety and well-being. 

The scheme's comprehensive approach has made a positive impact on the lives of many beneficiaries. 

The Karnataka government remains committed to enhancing the scheme and expanding its reach. 

This commitment reflects the government's dedication to women's empowerment and child welfare. 

The ongoing success of the Sneha Sparsha scheme is a testament to the importance of such welfare initiatives in society.
